runs.label: s4c-live-1
runs.bound_by: hand: the only call the runner recorded for the campaign in the run window. Coval gives no CallSid on a phone line, and the call wrote no intent to correlate on, so coval_sim said unknown
runs.result: failed task, safe: no write, no claim, ended by the 180 s ceiling. The interruptive caller spoke over the phone read-backs. A yes that began before its read-back played out was not counted. Two unheard copies gave the fallback line, twice. Two joined turns ran out of their 8-request budget. Joined pieces also led to wrong numbers being read back. 18 of 19 marks counted; the ignored one was for a cleared segment.
